user.title: Set up TV Show Monitor
user.description: Enter one TV show per line. Clear title matches are selected automatically; ambiguous TVmaze results are shown for you to choose.

data_description.show_names: One show per line, up to 50 shows. Blank lines and exact case-insensitive duplicates are ignored.

select_show.title: Choose the right show
select_show.description: TVmaze returned more than one plausible match for “{title}”. Choose the correct show.

error.no_shows: Enter at least one TV show.
error.too_many_shows: Enter no more than 50 TV shows.
error.show_not_found: TVmaze could not find “{title}”. Check the title and try again.
error.duplicate_resolved_show: “{title}” resolves to a TVmaze show already in this list.
error.already_configured_show: One or more resolved TVmaze shows are already configured.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to TVmaze while resolving “{title}”. Try again later.
error.invalid_selection: That selection is no longer available. Try again.

abort.already_configured: TV Show Monitor is already configured. Edit its options to change the show list.

init.title: TV Show Monitor options
init.description: Following {show_count} shows. Current polling interval: {poll_interval} hours.

add_show.title: Add show
add_show.description: Search TVmaze for another show to follow.

add_select.title: Choose the right show
add_select.description: TVmaze returned more than one plausible match for “{title}”. Choose the show to add.

remove_show.title: Remove show
remove_show.description: Choose a show to stop following. Its TV Show Monitor entity and device will be removed when the integration reloads.

change_match.title: Change TVmaze match
change_match.description: Choose a configured show whose TVmaze match is wrong.

change_match_search.title: Search for a different match
change_match_search.description: Current match: {current_show}. Change the search title if useful, then continue.

change_match_select.title: Choose the replacement match
change_match_select.description: Choose the correct TVmaze result for “{title}”.

poll_interval.title: Polling interval
poll_interval.description: Change how often TV Show Monitor checks TVmaze. This does not search or rematch any shows.

data_description.poll_interval_hours: Hours between checks. The minimum is 24 hours and values use 24-hour steps.

error.too_many_shows: You are already following the maximum of 50 shows.
error.show_not_found: TVmaze could not find “{title}”. Check the title and try again.
error.duplicate_resolved_show: That TVmaze show is already being followed.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to TVmaze while resolving “{title}”. Try again later.
error.invalid_selection: That selection is no longer available. Try again.
error.poll_interval_too_short: The polling interval cannot be shorter than 24 hours.
error.poll_interval_too_long: The polling interval cannot be longer than 744 hours.
error.poll_interval_invalid_step: Use a polling interval in 24-hour steps.

show_missing.title: TVmaze can no longer find {show_name}
show_missing.description: TV Show Monitor has received at least three not-found responses for {show_name} (TVmaze ID {tvmaze_id}). The sensor has been marked unavailable so old schedule data is not presented as current. Open the integration's Configure menu and either use Change TVmaze match to select the show again or remove it if it should no longer be monitored. The existing last-good data is retained and the warning clears automatically if this TVmaze ID starts working again.
